_readme: Canonical work_id registry for the Gold-Standard v2.6 URN cross-reference apparatus (Part B12 of DGE_Gold_Standard_Contract_v2_5.md, doc version 2.6). This is the CLOSED WORLD the AI extraction prompt is given: a cross_references[] entry may only cite a urn:dge:{work_id}:{locator} whose work_id appears below (B12.1). work_ids are immutable identity once used in any emitted urn -- never rename, deprecate via an alias map instead when that becomes necessary. locator_schema is the dot-joined path grammar for that work's own numbering (e.g. adhyaya.shloka -> '2.38'). 'ingested_path' points at the existing dge/data/**/data.json for a work already in the corpus (null if not yet ingested/OCR'd -- absence from the corpus is not a reason to omit a work_id here; B12.1's closed world only needs the identity to exist, not the content). This file is hand-maintained; add a row before extraction ever needs to cite a new work, per dge/GOLD_STANDARD_V26_PROMPT_ADDENDUM.md.

works.title: श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता
works.notes: The mula verses themselves. Not yet ingested as a standalone gold-standard unit set -- currently only present embedded inside commentary layers (gita_bhashya/mula, gita_tatparya_nirnaya/mula, and this session's gita-vivrtti extraction).

works.title: श्रीभगवद्गीताविवृतिः
works.author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रतीर्थः
works.notes: The work currently being extracted via the Gemini/OCR pipeline (extracted_gold_latest.json). Not yet merged into dge/data/ -- lives in the extraction pipeline's own output/ tree until a corpus placement pass runs.

works.title: गीताभाष्यम्
works.author: श्रीमध्वाचार्यः
works.notes: Also present under SarvaMula (dge/data/darshana/vedanta/dvaita/SarvaMula/gita_prasthana/gita_bhashya/mula/data.json). Legacy plain-string commentary schema today, not format:gold_v2_2 -- a real URN target, but resolvable only once its own gold-standard pass exists or the manifest falls back to the legacy shape.

works.title: गीतातात्पर्यनिर्णयः
works.author: श्रीमध्वाचार्यः
works.notes: Also present under SarvaMula. Distinct work from gita-bhashya -- tatparya may have scope up to the whole work (B5) and must not be conflated with a unit-level phalitartha.

works.title: गीताभाष्यम्
works.author: श्रीशङ्कराचार्यः
works.notes: Advaita bhashya on the same mula. A Dvaita vritti/tika citing or refuting this is exactly the voice:purvapakshin / stance:contra case B12.2 requires -- never machine-read a purvapakshin-voiced citation of this work as an endorsed pramana.

works.title: ब्रह्मसूत्राणि
works.author: श्रीवेदव्यासः (बादरायणः)
works.notes: Given as the contract's own B12.2 worked example (urn:dge:brahmasutra:4.1.3). Frequent inter_text cross-reference target from any Vedantic Gita commentary -- registered even though not yet located/confirmed ingested under this exact work_id, so extraction is never blocked from citing it (B12.1: absence from the corpus is not a reason to omit the identity).
